widget.title: How to interpret / 범위

text.content:
Project __PROJECT_ID__ / region __REGION__ / job __JOB_NAME__ / ID __JOB_ID__.
**No data = unknown, not zero.** Choose the actual job time range; native metrics can lag up to several minutes.
Oracle cursor reads ≠ post-JDBC output ≠ BigQuery confirmed rows. No percent-complete or confirmed BQ row counter is available.
Native filter charts retain individual series and 60-second maxima; ratio uses sampled PromQL observations. Never sum cumulative gauge samples or PCollections.
[Dataflow Job](https://console.cloud.google.com/dataflow/jobs/__REGION__/__JOB_ID__?project=__PROJECT_ID__)

widget.title: Current vCPUs (not worker count)

timeSeriesFilter.filter: metric.type="dataflow.googleapis.com/job/current_num_vcpus" AND resource.type="dataflow_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.region="__REGION__" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__" AND metric.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__"

widget.title: Failure flag: 1=failed; job-name scoped (select run time)

timeSeriesFilter.filter: metric.type="dataflow.googleapis.com/job/is_failed" AND resource.type="dataflow_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.region="__REGION__" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__"

widget.title: Container memory used (bytes; individual worker/container)

timeSeriesFilter.filter: metric.type="dataflow.googleapis.com/worker/memory/bytes_used" AND resource.type="dataflow_worker" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__"

widget.title: Container memory limit (bytes; not usage)

timeSeriesFilter.filter: metric.type="dataflow.googleapis.com/worker/memory/container_limit" AND resource.type="dataflow_worker" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__"

widget.title: PCollection elements so far (not source/BQ rows)

timeSeriesFilter.filter: metric.type="dataflow.googleapis.com/job/element_count" AND resource.type="dataflow_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.region="__REGION__" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__" AND metric.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__"

widget.title: PCollection estimated bytes so far (not stored-file bytes)

timeSeriesFilter.filter: metric.type="dataflow.googleapis.com/job/estimated_byte_count" AND resource.type="dataflow_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.region="__REGION__" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__" AND metric.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__"

widget.title: SDK counters: locate post_jdbc_output_rows (after barrier)

timeSeriesFilter.filter: metric.type="dataflow.googleapis.com/job/user_counter" AND resource.type="dataflow_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.region="__REGION__" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__" AND metric.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__"

widget.title: Total shuffle bytes processed (gauge; not retained disk bytes)

timeSeriesFilter.filter: metric.type="dataflow.googleapis.com/job/total_shuffle_data_processed" AND resource.type="dataflow_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.region="__REGION__" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__" AND metric.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__"

widget.title: Composer stage snapshots / unknown / API observation errors
Worker FILE_LOADS references (submitted load != success)
Worker errors and OOM evidence (not automatic diagnosis)

logsPanel.filter: resource.type="dataflow_step" AND resource.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__" AND (severity>=ERROR OR "OutOfMemoryError" OR "OOMKilled" OR "MemoryError")

widget.title: Observed container memory ratio (%) - matched worker/container
Worker total RAM limit (bytes; not used/GB-seconds)

timeSeriesFilter.filter: metric.type="dataflow.googleapis.com/worker/memory/total_limit" AND resource.type="dataflow_worker" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__"

widget.title: OOM detector marker / exception candidates (not proven kernel kills)

logsPanel.filter: resource.type="dataflow_step" AND resource.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__" AND ("Successfully wrote OOM event" OR "OutOfMemoryError" OR "MemoryError" OR "OOMKilled")

widget.title: Java heap / GC pressure candidates (inspect full context)

logsPanel.filter: resource.type="dataflow_step" AND resource.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__" AND ("Java heap space" OR "GC overhead limit exceeded" OR "GC thrashing" OR "measured GC thrashing")

widget.title: cgroup / killed process candidates (job-scoped; not diagnosis)

logsPanel.filter: resource.type="dataflow_step" AND resource.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__" AND ("Memory cgroup out of memory" OR "oom-kill" OR "Killed process" OR "OOMKilled")

widget.title: SDK disconnect / worker loss candidates (may not be OOM)

logsPanel.filter: resource.type="dataflow_step" AND resource.labels.job_id="__JOB_ID__" AND ("SDK harness disconnected" OR "SDK harness connection lost" OR "SDK harness is disconnected" OR "worker lost contact" OR "Worker lost contact")

widget.title: Kernel VM logs - worker correlation required

text.content: Not queried by default. After verifying this Job owns a worker VM, render with --worker-instance-id, --worker-zone and --confirmed-worker-job-id. gce_instance has no job_id resource label. No project-wide killed-process search is performed. Missing kernel logs do not rule out OOM.

widget.title: Known limits / 다음 확인

text.content:
BQ confirmed row count is **unsupported** here: load references mean SUBMITTED_REFERENCE_OBSERVED/current_state unknown; copy SUCCESS_OUTPUT_OBSERVED is a completion-output observation, not a live API status query. Open the recorded BQ job ID for its actual status.
post_jdbc_output_rows is in namespace jdbc_export_progress and only exists after deploying the progress image. metric_name export spelling may differ: the chart intentionally shows all SDK user counters; inspect labels before narrowing it. Zero downstream output does not prove Oracle has not read rows.
Container memory is native measured bytes, not total memory GB-seconds or an invented percent. Missing memory series means unavailable, not healthy.
Composer logs require the executor progress code; worker logs/counter require the new image/template. No custom/log-based metric is created.
OOM panels show matching log context, not a deduplicated OOM event count or automatic root cause; negated text and retries may match. Ratio joins the same worker/container, drops absent/nonpositive limits, and uses sampled observations (not real-time or exact peak). JVM heap/GC numeric, process RSS and cgroup event collection are not installed.
